title: Delio is established in South Korea
description: Delio was established as a South Korean digital-asset financial-services company and later developed centralized savings, lending, staking, and asset-management products.
notes: The month is supported by company-profile material; the first day is an approximate sortable date rather than a verified incorporation day.

title: Delio launches expanded crypto-bank service
description: Delio announced a crypto-bank service combining crypto deposit, withdrawal, lending, asset-transaction, and yield-oriented account features after obtaining Korean VASP registration for its business model.
notes: Delio had offered lending and savings products before this launch; this event records the expanded crypto-bank branding rather than the first Delio product.

title: Delio suspends customer withdrawals
description: Delio halted customer withdrawals at 18:30 Korea time after Haru Invest suspended deposits and withdrawals and stress spread through the local crypto-yield market.
notes: Later statements discussed phased or product-limited resumptions, but normal platform-wide withdrawals were not shown to have been fully restored.

title: Korean FIU imposes business suspension and fine
description: The Korea Financial Intelligence Unit imposed a three-month business suspension and a fine of approximately KRW 1.896 billion for violations of Korean virtual-asset-business compliance obligations.
notes: The decision was made on 31 August 2023 and publicly reported on 1 September 2023.

title: Court rejects Delio rehabilitation application
description: The Seoul Rehabilitation Court dismissed Delio's rehabilitation application, citing the prolonged inability to conduct business, uncertainty around any restart, and doubts that going-concern value exceeded liquidation value.
notes: The dismissal moved the creditor case away from rehabilitation but preceded the later bankruptcy declaration.

title: Seoul Bankruptcy Court declares Delio bankrupt
description: The Seoul Bankruptcy Court declared Delio bankrupt after finding grounds of payment inability based on the withdrawal halt, operating shutdown, and creditor situation, initiating liquidation and claim administration.
notes: The event date is the court declaration date. It is not a final valuation or recovery date for every customer claim.
